config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set uuid 247dec38-ddfe-51f1-1513-18df0d304f13
        set srcintf "internal"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set nat enable
    next
end
